A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GLSim study. Their complete main text, Appendices A–F, equations, 12 tables, and 13 figures are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original hallucination-detection experiments on MSCOCO and Objects365, with additional model evaluations, ablations, qualitative analyses, and attribute/relation experiments in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark in Table 1 and the additional experiments in Appendices B, D, and E.

M1.justification: The procedure is unchanged: Visual Logit Lens selects relevant patches, local and global cosine similarities are computed, and their weighted combination produces GLSim. Equations (2)–(5) and the appendix adaptations are retained.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate object existence on MSCOCO and Objects365, attribute/relation hallucinations on MSCOCO, and the same POPE-style verification scenario. No dataset, domain, or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1, 7, and 8 retain NLL, Entropy, Internal Confidence, SVAR, and Contextual Lens. Tables 9–10 retain POPE and the external-model comparator. The newly cited Halluentity work is not added as an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: The model configurations, 5,000-image samples per main dataset, CHAIR-style matching, AUROC/AUPR evaluation, and Appendix A settings are unchanged. Appendix D retains the 500-image GPT-4o-annotated extension and the same F1-based threshold selection for the POPE comparison.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 retains the component, grounding, patch-count, weighting, and layer ablations. Appendices B, D, and E retain the same qualitative examples, score distributions, multi-token and distance-metric studies, and layer-performance matrices.

E5.justification: Both versions already report averages over three random seeds in Appendix A and means with standard deviations in Table 1. No run-count or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: The matched numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains GLSim's LLaVA-1.5-7B AUROC values of 83.7±0.3 on MSCOCO and 72.6±0.5 on Objects365.

T1.justification: Definition 3.1, the method equations, and the baseline formulas in Appendix C are unchanged. Neither version adds or removes formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same training-free global/local detection contribution, benchmarking claim, and performance/generalization claims. The added 'self-evaluate' wording describes the existing model-internal operation rather than a new capability.

C2.justification: The explanations of global/local complementarity, failure cases, and applicability remain unchanged. Appendix D.2 condenses repetitive discussion of missing fine-grained benchmarks while retaining that limitation; Section 6's limitations and future directions are unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 adds a first-page footnote stating that code is available and providing a repository address, absent from v1. This improves documented access information; Appendix A's implementation, hyperparameter, software, and hardware details are unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds Yeh et al.'s Halluentity: Benchmarking and understanding entity-level hallucination detection as reference 64 and cites it in Appendix C.2. This is a limited citation addition; the broader positioning and novelty argument remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized grammatical and terminology edits, adjusts paragraph breaks and cross-reference wording, and condenses Appendix D.2. It also changes the displayed author name from Yixuan Li to Sharon Li. The overall document organization is retained.

P2.justification: All figures and tables retain their content and structure, with modest spacing and placement changes, including around Figures 9 and 10. The first page gains a code footnote and replaces the preprint footer with the NeurIPS 2025 conference footer.

improvement.justification: v3 improves reproducibility documentation by adding a code-access pointer and modestly improves attribution through the Halluentity citation, alongside small editorial refinements. The method, empirical evidence, and substantive limitations remain unchanged, so the overall improvement is limited.
